geDeveloper.title: Frontend Developer
geDeveloper.about: I'm Godwin Emmanuel, a self-taught frontend developer who enjoys turning ideas into functional, responsive, and visually engaging websites. I learn by building real-world projects, exploring new technologies, and continuously improving my skills. Outside coding, I enjoy anime, gaming, animation, and the creative side of technology.
